It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 2013.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 28, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district covers central and southern Cotabato bordering [[Maguindanao]] to the west and [[Lanao del Sur]] to the north. It consists of the municipalities of [[Banisilan]], [[Carmen, Cotabato|Carmen]], [[Kabacan]], [[M'lang]], [[Matalam]] and [[Tulunan]].{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2012/09/14/republic-act-no-10177/ |title=Republic Act No. 10177 |date=14 September 2012 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 28, 2021}} The district contains several [[Special geographic area of Bangsamoro|exclaves of the Bangsamoro autonomous region]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Samantha Santos]] of the [[Lakas-CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 28, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
